# PS Steels & Engineering

> Steel fabrication workshop in Mannarkkad, Palakkad, serving all of Kerala.
> SS (Grade 304/316), MS, GP pipe and steel pipe fabrication for homes,
> hotels, bakeries, catering teams and event organisers.

Contact: +91 97475 15022 — info@pssteels.in
Address: Vattambalam, Mannarkkad, Palakkad, Kerala 678582, India
GSTIN: 32EGQPP3743B1ZF
Hours: Mon–Sat, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM

## Services

- [SS & MS Steel Fabrication](https://pssteels.in/services): Custom stainless and mild steel works for residential, commercial and industrial projects.
- [GP Pipe & Steel Pipe Works](https://pssteels.in/services): Handrails, gates, roofing structures and custom pipe fabrication.
- [Handrail & Staircase Works](https://pssteels.in/services): Modern SS handrails, balcony railings, staircase fabrication and safety railings.
- [Gate & Sitout Works](https://pssteels.in/services): Main gates, sliding gates, sitout structures, grills, decorative steel art.
- [Hotel & Bakery Fabrication](https://pssteels.in/services): SS commercial kitchens, bakery counters, exhaust hoods, prep tables.
- [Catering Counter Fabrication](https://pssteels.in/services): Buffet, chafing and mobile serving units for functions and hotels.
- [Event & Wedding Stage Steel](https://pssteels.in/services): Truss frames, decoration support structures, modular setups.
- [Sheet & Pipe Bending](https://pssteels.in/services): Hydraulic pipe bending, sheet metal bending, custom radius and angle works.
- [Steel Furniture Works](https://pssteels.in/services): Tables, chairs, racks, storage units, commercial furniture.
- [Custom Fabrication on Demand](https://pssteels.in/services): Made-to-order based on your design, size and site.
